blocks.text: Members of transport group MANIBELA received sacks of rice from the government’s “Bawat Bayan Makikinabang” program. First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos led the rice distribution at the Land Transportation Office (LTO) compound in Quezon City on Tuesday, September 29.
